description: Update a post of any post type. Only the given fields change; meta keys are merged (update_post_meta per key).

content.description: Post content. Note: the endpoint sanitizes it as plain text, so HTML tags are stripped

meta.description: Post meta key-value pairs to set

type.description: Post type name (e.g. post, page, product, testimonial)

name: mcp_update_cpt_post
